note: The AI policy (netlify/lib/orchestrator/policy.mjs) as reviewed. tools/ai-policy-gate.mjs fails when the code's policy hash differs from `current`, so every rule or prompt change needs a new version and a changelog entry here. `released` is the policy last deployed to production; a deploy that changes it is refused from Friday 12:00 to Sunday (IST) unless AI_POLICY_WINDOW_OVERRIDE gives a reason.

history.change: First orchestrator policy: identity from the session, consent + per-request sharing, read-only tools, evidence-only facts, validated explanations, routing A-D with no silent downgrade.

The assistant may PROPOSE one action (a reminder time for a medicine already listed), behind the ai_actions switch; the person reviews it in the medicine editor and the app saves it; the server verifies afterwards.
